# k8s-manifest-security

> Check Kubernetes workload manifests against Pod Security Standards baseline and restricted controls plus image and memory limit hygiene, with exact field paths and stable rule codes Go module `github.com/Trysac/u257-k8s-manifest-security`, package `k8smanifestsecurity`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
